subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
For an n-channel MOSFET biased in the saturation 
region, the parameters are Kn = 0.5 mA/V2, VTN = 0.8 
V,  = 0.01 V–1, and IDQ = 0.75 mA. The value of gm 
and r0 are   
 
(a) 0.68 mS, 603 kΩ  
(b) 1.22 mS, 603 kΩ 
 
(c) 1.22 mS, 133 kΩ  
(d) 0.68 mS, 133 kΩ
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-04 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 04).
